test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 2 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: As of July 2022, under the National Pension Scheme for Traders and Self-employed Persons, beneficiaries are entitled to receive minimum monthly assured pension of how much after attaining the age of 60 years?
solution:
The correct answer is__ Rs. 3000.__

__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__

__
 
• NPS for traders and self employed persons.__

 __
 
• ​__In 2019, the Modi administration introduced the National Pension Scheme (NPS) for independent contractors and traders. These people, whose annual turnover is Rs 1.5 crore or less, can ensure their future with the NPS scheme.
 
• The programme is designed to provide social security and old age protection for independent contractors, business owners, and retail traders. These retail traders, shopkeepers, oil mill owners, workshop owners, commission agents, real estate brokers, owners of small hotels, restaurants, and other Laghu Vyaparis are the main occupations of these self-employed individuals and retail traders.
 
• A minimum assured income of Rs. 3000 per month is provided under this voluntary and contributory pension plan for members who reach the age of 60. If the subscriber dies, the spouse of the beneficiary shall be entitled to receive 50 per cent of the pension as family pension. The family pension is applicable only to spouse.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

__
 
• Eligibility requirements__- The following are the requirements to be eligible for the NPS programme:

 __
 
• 1) The person must be a retail trader, store owner, or self-employed
 
• 2) The applicant's entering age must be between 18 and 40 years old.
 
• 3) The traders' or self-employed individuals' yearly turnover must be Rs. 1.5 crore or less.
 
 
 
• Documents are necessary__
 __
 
• The Aadhar card and a Savings Bank Account / Jan Dhan account number with an IFSC are requirements for NPS enrolment.
 
 
 
• Contribution from business owners and independent contractors__
 __
 
• From the date of joining NPS-Traders until the age of 60, the traders' and self-employed individuals' contributions will be made using the "auto-debit" feature from their savings bank accounts or Jan-Dhan accounts. The central government will also give equal matching contribution in his pension account.
 
 
 
• 
 
Should not be__ - engaged in Organised sector, not be the beneficiary of PM-SYM, and should not be income taxpayer.
